trap-rhetorical-pivot.notes: STRUCTURAL DEFECTS reported, not fixed: (1) BUILD-FATAL -- one ```tex fence opens before the tikzcd and is never closed (fence count is 1, odd), so the remainder of the block falls inside raw passthrough. (2) INTERNAL CONTRADICTION -- the prose says 'Photon absorption executes a Reidemeister I move on the trefoil embedding... This adds a curl at the exceptional divisor and increases the writhe by +2', while the display three lines later reads 'n -> n+1 <=> w -> w+2 <=> two R-I moves at exceptional divisor', and the sibling table hydrogen-orbital-tables lists '+2' R-I moves per unit shell.
